images.scene: Dramatic medium shot inside an old general store: a defeated shop owner slumped forward over his wooden counter, head bowed down onto his crossed forearms, LARGE in the frame, filling most of the width, seen slightly from the front, dark work clothes, while many plain unmarked banknotes swirl and float in the air close around his head and shoulders, suspended mid-fall, backlit by a flood of bright hazy light from above. The man, the counter and all floating banknotes occupy the lower two thirds of the frame; the counter bleeds off the bottom edge. The top third of the image is completely empty, blown-out, overexposed, glowing near-white haze with no objects in it. All banknotes completely plain with no readable text, no numbers and no portraits, 1950s.
